messages.subject: RE: what is the difference between RHIPE,Hadoop Streaming ,Hive R packages to run on R on hadoop
parts:
Hi,
Their purpose are different depending on the scenarios/problems you want
to solve.
RHIPE is specifically designed for Batch jobs, and hive for querying
like sql queries etc. RHipe internally uses Hadoop streaming facility
to interact with Hadoop.

Like R, python, Ruby etc interacts with Hadoop using streaming.Infact
all those languages which can read and write std inputs and outputs they
can interact with Hadoop.
